late_source_policy: no new entries outside 900 seconds; all fresh candidates must pass the live execution-adjusted +50-bps gate
entry_order: market after target-free scoring, MC1 admission, all-admitted live book preflight, execution-EV ranking, and retained portfolio caps
execution_adjusted_ev: MC1_expected_net_bps - adverse_delay_gap_bps - min(80 bps, 1.2 * live_full_spread_bps + 2 * entry_impact_bps); adjusted EV must remain at least +50 bps at preflight and after fill
entry_price_move_guard: reject any entry whose executable preflight quote or realised fill differs from original validated signal decision-open price by more than 100 bps in either direction
entry_price_source_guard: official hourly entry-open fallback requires positive trade volume and a contemporaneous decision-timestamp official-book midpoint deviation of no more than 100 bps; otherwise candidate fails closed before scoring
live_auction: preflight every MC1-admitted and base-routed candidate at the same 10-percent margin slot; rank passing candidates by execution-adjusted EV; only then enforce at most two new entries, eight concurrent positions, one position per symbol and the 80-percent margin cap
protective_stop: exchange-side reduce-only stop installed immediately after fill; any failure immediately flattens the entry
position_monitor: persistent pre-existing minute monitor manages only already-open positions using SimplePolicyOptimiser parent plus Adaptive Exit V1 overlay
adaptive_exit_role: activation-only modulation of the SimplePolicyOptimiser parent; parent activation is the fallback
independent_replay_role: offline audit only; never blocks fresh execution
